text: Hello, sorry, I'm quite scared and I'm not sure if I'm overreacting. My stepdaughter is 3 and her temperature has gone up to 39.1. Her dad's working nights so it's just me. Her eczema is really flaring up too, she's got those dry rough itchy patches on the backs of her knees and inside her elbows and she keeps scratching them. I read online you should press a glass on any red bits so I did, and the patches went pale under it, and there's no other rash on her apart from the eczema. I also checked her neck because that seemed to be the other thing everyone says, and I think it's fine, she can bend right down and look at her toes no problem. My main question is the medicine. She weighs about 14kg I think and I honestly don't know how much Calpol or ibuprofen I'm supposed to give her or whether I can give both. The bottle in the cupboard is the 1-6 years one I think? I don't want to get it wrong. I also don't know if the eczema cream is ok to keep using with a temperature. Sorry for the long message
